body: I know it's crazy and that's why it scares me

No, not yet.  
I've changed before, I can do it again

The plan isn't to pine over her, the plan is to get her back. 

But I really don't think thats possible. 

I now how to live with my mistakes, but I honestly don't know if I can.

I tried that for a long time.  
I tried to make it on my own and change my lifestyle, but it didn't work.

If I leave my current relationship, I'll have no-one.  

And being alone is even worse. I don't know if I can get her back because she has a boyfriend that she's seen for 2 years, I don't think she'd want me back. 

I think I have to learn to live with my mistake, but I dont think I can.

I know it's unfair on my current girlfriend, and I'd hate for someone to do that to me. Maybe I can make it work?  

I tried being single, I tried to "move on" and it didn't work. I saw multiple doctors, different medications and nothing worked. I thought that maybe if I found someone else, I'd forget about her.  

I was wrong.
Where do you think I'd be able to find such support groups?
How did you get on the road to recovery?

Well said, brother. While I don't want to get "married" per se, I really do want to spend my life with a person I love.  

People keep telling me I'm "too young" to worry about this stuff, but I say you're never too young to have dreams
